features.name: MCP data tools (find tables, table relations, table schema, data query)
features.summary: Four new system tools are enabled through the data tool server feature, letting the LLM in an MCP host build AL queries that Business Central compiles and runs, returning the data with no APIs needed. Compile failures return messages straight from the Business Central compiler, so the agent can often correct itself before running the final queries.

Agent only sometimes corrects itself (described as 'often times')

features.name: Call graph analysis (AL tool graph command)
features.summary: The AL .NET tool gets a graph command that builds a call graph across an extension and its dependencies. You or a coding agent can query it, for example to find who can call an internal procedure, where the public boundary is, or the path from a page action to a method. It is a static offline analysis, so output can be compared between versions.
caveats: Extraction compiles all specified apps and takes time, so it was done in advance for the demo
Static analysis works on the extracted data, not on the project as it is now like the LSP
A separate full session on the graph tool will cover querying and visualizing the graph in more detail; a link is in the description
prerequisites: al .NET tool, where the agentic tools live

features.name: Default implementation for interface methods
features.summary: Interface methods can now have a default implementation, so consumers do not have to implement newly added methods. This lets interfaces grow over many releases without breaking existing implementers. A consumer sees a warning that a default exists and can still implement its own logic.

quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the design reason for default implementations on interfaces.

quotes.text: So now with the default implementation we can extend an interface and build our solution across many releases without breaking any of our consumers.
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the outcome: interfaces can evolve without breaking implementers.

release_plan.title: Evolve AL interfaces with default implementations
release_plan.note: Default method bodies on AL interfaces.
